{{Quote|I told you that kid was strange.|The Arcona, on Bayrn, to a human|<ref name="Identity Crisis" />}}
An '''Arcona''' was present at a street market on the [[planet]] [[Caraad]] alongside a [[human]] [[Unidentified human (Caraad)|accomplice]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. After witnessing the [[Force-sensitive]] [[Tarlafar]] [[Bayrn]] use [[the Force]] while at a market, the [[Arcona]] mentioned to the human that Bayrn is "gifted," which led the human to respond that the Arcona should not mention stuff like that while in public.<ref name="Identity Crisis" />
